title: Elon Musk's Cybertruck pivot highlights the founder-CEO advantage
summary:
With Elon Musk reportedly preparing to pull the plug on Tesla's (TSLA) Cybertruck production line within eight months and warning that the company may have to refund customer deposits, questions are emerging about the advantages of founder-led leadership. Kelly Intelligence Founder, CEO, and CCO Kevin Kelly and his panel of experts examine why founders may have greater freedom to make bold decisions and change course compared with a hired CEO.

Today's panel includes Julie Biel, Kayne Anderson Rudnick, Chief Market Strategist, Portfolio Manager & Senior Research Analyst; Michael Monaghan, Founder, ETFs Partner and Portfolio Manager; and Dave Nadig, ETF.com president.

title: Nvidia $5T CEO scandal, AI legislation headaches, and Tesla returns deposits for Cybertrucks
summary:
Host Kevin Kelly, Kelly Intelligence Founder, CEO, and CCO, and his panel of experts weigh in on Nvidia's (NVDA) Jensen Huang alleged affair with a Chinese spy, plus Tesla (TSLA) CEO Elon Musk, confirming the company will refund deposits to many Cybertruck reservation holders because outstanding orders exceed remaining production capacity

Today's panel includes Julie Biel, Kayne Anderson Rudnick, Chief Market Strategist, Portfolio Manager & Senior Research Analyst; Michael Monaghan, Founder, ETFs Partner and Portfolio Manager; and Dave Nadig, ETF.com president.
